component.name: Argus
component.summary: Modern, fluid video player, music player & streaming companion

description.p: Argus is an ultra-responsive, privacy-centric media player and streaming hub featuring mpv-accelerated video and music playback, Apple Music-style radio and audio streams, smart subtitle auto-synchronization, and multi-profile tracking.

ul.li: Windows x64 & ARM64 build fixes for sysinfo 0.40 and libmpv staging
Android native torrent bridge compatibility with jni 0.21
Native iOS/iPadOS archive pipeline via tauri ios build
Zero-vulnerability security hardening and Liquid Glass UI parity
Zero-vulnerability security hardening with CodeQL static analysis automation
Apple Liquid Glass harmonized UI design across player overlays and menus
AZSO fast-start streaming engine upgrades (stages 1-5) for low-latency playback
Multi-platform release automation for macOS, Windows x64/ARM64, Linux Flatpak/deb/rpm, iOS, Android, and Smart TVs
Apple Music-grade Radio view with live streams and custom audio stream tuner
Resilient SQLite catalog caching and instant offline playback recovery
Apple Music multi-hue gradient meshes for artist and album artwork
Windows ARM64 native target support and Flatpak bundle pipeline
